mode: synthetic CPU exact VectorIndex only; no Hydra inference, no artwork, no ANN

50k_attempt.reason: Per-row transactional insertion had consumed about 78 CPU seconds by 35,141 rows; projected total approached/exceeded the requested two-minute practicality limit. Partial synthetic database is retained and must not be treated as a 50k benchmark.

methodology.vector_source: deterministic synthetic Gaussian vectors, normalized to float32 unit length; generated incrementally, one VectorIndex.upsert transaction per row
methodology.cold_definition: first query after close/reopen; filesystem/OS cache was not flushed, so this is not a true cold-storage measurement
methodology.warm_queries: 25 independent queries per 1k and 8k run; p50/p95 over those latencies
methodology.rss: measured in a separate repeat-query process using Win32 GetProcessMemoryInfo; it is not the original insert process peak
methodology.exactness: top-32 compared against independent NumPy brute-force L2 over all rows at 1k and 8k
methodology.dedup_case: identical normalized vector and media hashes at sorted row positions 512 and 513; queried that vector and checked one lower-ID representative
